Created `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/reflect/MethodUtilsAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering `MethodUtils`:

- All `getAccessibleMethod` overloads, including null-handling and unknown-method cases.
- `getAnnotation`, including the `searchSupers` contract (verified via a subclass that overrides a method without copying its annotation) and NPE cases.
- `getMatchingAccessibleMethod` (wrapper-type/primitive matching, no-arg, unknown method) and `getMatchingMethod` (private method lookup, null-params-as-empty, NPE on null class, and the documented `IllegalStateException` for an ambiguous match).
- `getMethodObject` found/not-found.
- `getMethodsListWithAnnotation`/`getMethodsWithAnnotation` in both 2-arg and 4-arg forms, exercising `searchSupers`/`ignoreAccess` combinations against a fixture hierarchy with a public inherited annotated method and a private declared annotated method, plus NPE cases.
- `getOverrideHierarchy` with `Interfaces.INCLUDE`/`EXCLUDE`, checking ascending subclass→superclass order and NPE on null method.
- All `invokeExactMethod`/`invokeExactStaticMethod`/`invokeMethod`/`invokeStaticMethod` overloads, asserting actual returned values, boxing/primitive matching, `forceAccess` behavior, exact-match failures, NPE on null object, `NoSuchMethodException` for unknown methods, and `InvocationTargetException` wrapping with cause assertions.

Compiled cleanly with `./compile.sh` (no other files modified); build artifacts (`out/`, `.sources`) were removed afterward.
